propositions: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on live tickets branch with 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"' JQL parse error because projects.json contains nonexistent rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot builds one inbound query per key in read_projects().keys(); when projects.json holds invalid keys, the first jql_active query is rejected by Jira causing ACLI exit 1 and reconcile_once to raise.

Live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture mapping via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e, authored by test-fixture identity) instead of the canonical seed state {legacy_default: REB, projects: {}, version: 1}.

The projects.json write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project) lacks write lock, atomic commit, and auto-publish semantics, enabling ad-hoc hand-commits that bypass the unified store contract.
